description: This file defines a RuntimeCache class that manages a cache of runtime states identified by actor keys. It provides methods to add, retrieve, delete, and snapshot cache entries, as well as to collect idle candidates based on a maximum idle time. It relies on external runtime type definitions.

classes.name: RuntimeCache
classes.description: A cache object to store and manage runtime states associated with actor keys, including methods for cache manipulations and retrievals.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for the given actor key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for the given actor key, optionally updating the last touched timestamp.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for the given actor key without updating the last touched timestamp.

methods.name: getLastTouchedAt
methods.description: Returns the last touched timestamp for the specified actor key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a runtime state in the cache with an associated actor key and current timestamp.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the cache entry for the specified actor key.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of all cache entries with their idle durations.

methods.name: collectIdleCandidates
methods.description: Returns all cache entries where the idle time exceeds the specified maximum idle milliseconds.

ctags.name: cache
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();$/

fields.name: private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();
